startup.title: The app could not open its data

interface.title: Interface
interface.effectsHint: On Linux the reduced mode replaces blur with a solid overlay.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.lead: Downloaded books are saved to this folder. There is no Save As dialog — change the folder here.

reader.title: Reader
reader.lead: If no path is set, the book opens with the application the system associates with this file type.

covers.title: Covers
covers.lead: Covers are read from the archives and cached on disk. You can delete the cache — the app will rebuild it.
covers.clearBody: Cached cover files will be removed. They will be extracted again as you browse. This cannot be undone.
covers.warmupCount: {n} book will be processed | {n} books will be processed

personal.title: Personal data
personal.lead: Export and import ratings, notes and want-to-read marks. The file can be moved to another installation of the app.
personal.previewEmpty: The file has no rows that can be applied.
personal.confirmBody: Only older local values will be updated. A catalog backup is made before writing.
personal.notFound: {n} book not found | {n} books not found

reason.notFound: the book is not in the catalog
reason.noTimestamp: no timestamp, and a local value already exists

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.lead: The key is stored in the operating system credential store or in an encrypted file. The app never shows the key itself.
ai.secretPlaceholder: The key is not shown after it is saved
ai.storeOS: The key is stored in the operating system credential store.
ai.storeFile: The operating system store is unavailable, so the key is in an encrypted file.
ai.storeMachineId: The machine identifier is unavailable, so a file key next to the app data is used.
ai.hasKey: A key for this provider is saved.
ai.noKey: No key is saved for this provider yet.
ai.statusEmpty: The secret store status could not be loaded.

maintenance.title: Database
maintenance.lead: Optimization refreshes planner statistics and may shrink the file a little. It does not promise free space. A manual copy goes to the backup folder and does not replace copies taken before an import.
maintenance.confirmBody: The catalog file will be rebuilt in full. Free space of about twice the database size is required. If there is nothing to shrink, the app says so instead of reporting zero.
maintenance.closeBody: Optimization or a backup has not finished yet. Closing the window now will interrupt the operation.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.lead: Paths, versions and counters for this installation. Ratings, notes and books are not included in a diagnostics archive.
diagnostics.unnamedCount: {n} untitled genre code | {n} untitled genre codes
diagnostics.unnamedHint: To set names, create a genres.local.json file in the data folder.
diagnostics.archiveHint: The archive includes logs, versions, configuration without secrets, database statistics and folder paths. It does not include ratings, notes or books.
diagnostics.archiveTitle: Where to save the diagnostics archive

issue.title: Report a problem
issue.lead: The app does not send anything by itself. You see the full text and choose whether to open an issue, copy it or save a file.
issue.descriptionPlaceholder: What happened, or what you would like to see
issue.previewLead: This is what will go into the issue or the file. You can edit any part.
issue.urlTooLong: The report is too large for a link. Save the file and attach it to the issue yourself.
issue.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
